headline: Beijing AI+ Conference reports launch of ReAct-Manip robot adaptation evaluation set
summary: An official Beijing AI+ Conference recap dated October 31 says the event launched ReAct-Manip, a robot operation-adaptation evaluation set. The recap names the benchmark but gives no technical specification, scores or model comparisons. A separate news report also describes the release. The PyPI ReAct-Manip v0.3 package has not been tied to the conference announcement, so its protocol and any capability implications remain unestablished.
